content.text: Digital creators across the globe face significant hurdles in establishing effective [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how-4|Payment Gateways]] processing systems for their products. In regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are either unavailable or heavily restricted, the need for a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-3|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] becomes critical. The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-8|architecture]] behind crypto payment gateways offers a sovereign solution that eliminates high fees and dependency on traditional platforms. This post dissects how you can effectively sell digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates without the limitations imposed by conventional services.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The architecture of crypto payment gateways fundamentally transforms how digital creators can conduct transactions. By circumventing traditional payment processors, creators can capitalize on lower fees and enhanced autonomy. This is especially crucial in regions where financial systems are unstable or limited. The flexibility of using cryptocurrencies allows for real-time transactions without the burdens typically associated with conventional payment platforms. Understanding this architecture not only empowers creators but also positions them to harness the benefits of a rapidly evolving digital economy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a crypto payment gateway operates using blockchain technology, facilitating transactions without intermediary platforms. The integration of tools like NOWPayments allows for seamless payment processing in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring that creators receive funds with minimal fees—just 0.5% compared to up to 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad. The use of Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script enables automated delivery of digital products, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation. This infrastructure not only enhances efficiency but also guarantees greater control over sales data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is tailored for digital creators in regions facing financial restrictions and high platform fees. Whether you are selling ebooks, online courses, or digital templates, the architecture accommodates those who have been excluded from mainstream payment solutions. By adopting this model, creators gain sovereignty over their sales processes, eliminating reliance on platforms that charge exorbitant fees and impose limitations. This is not merely a workaround; it is a complete overhaul of how digital goods can be sold effectively and profitably.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% compared to up to 10% from platforms like Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The foundation of this architecture comprises several key components: a hosting solution (like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and storage options such as Supabase or Google Sheets. Together with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, these elements create a cohesive system that is both functional and efficient. Each component is designed to work together seamlessly, ensuring that digital creators can focus on their products rather than the complexities of payment processing.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To leverage this architecture, start by selecting the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, both of which are ready for deployment in 48 hours. Next, configure your chosen stack to include your digital products, ensuring that the NOWPayments integration is properly set up. Utilize the resources provided in the Complete Builder Kit to guide you through the process and optimize your setup for maximum efficiency. Finally, launch your store and begin selling with confidence, knowing that you have built a resilient payment infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a crypto payment gateway that supports cryptocurrency transactions. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies, enabling you to bypass traditional payment processors. This approach not only reduces transaction costs but also provides immediate access to your funds.
Automated delivery ensures instant access to digital products for your customers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in building a digital store without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to establish your sovereign commerce stack, allowing you to sell digital products efficiently and independently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a crypto payment gateway for my digital products?

To set up a crypto payment gateway, choose a service like NOWPayments. Integrate it with your website using backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Ensure your digital products are uploaded to a reliable storage solution for seamless delivery.
What fees should I expect with crypto payment processing?

Crypto payment processing fees vary but are typically much lower than traditional platforms. For instance, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, whereas platforms like Gumroad can charge up to 10% on sales, saving you significant amounts.
Can I sell digital products without a traditional payment processor?

Yes, you can sell digital products without traditional payment processors by using a crypto payment gateway. This allows you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies directly, eliminating the need for platforms like PayPal or Stripe.
What types of digital products can I sell with this setup?

You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and software. The infrastructure supports automated delivery, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly.
Is it possible to scale my sales with this architecture?
Absolutely. This architecture is designed for scalability. As your sales grow, you can easily add more products and leverage the low fees of crypto payments to maximize your earnings.
You own your entire stack with no dependencies on third-party platforms.
